detail: Fresh owner-authorized Mopan creation tab in the explicitly selected existing Chrome profile. No prior project/context, template or uploaded assets. Profile was owner-confirmed, not machine-attested. Preparation precedes paid generation.

Main model changed to Gemini 4 Argon · Google; Child remained Same as Main. Visible UI label, not backend identity attestation. Effort, deployed harness version, account tier and model cost not exposed. Selection action was at 04:01:16.321–04:01:16.540 UTC.

Clicked the actual Generate/Send button at 04:08:50.536–04:08:50.768 UTC after entering the frozen prompt. Method commit 362e3cc40eefb33e0987ffa6592076187c07cd63 was pushed before Send; method PR #3 was opened just afterward, not approved before execution.

First observed accepted prompt in a new workspace, Thinking and Stop task visible. This is an observer receipt timestamp, not exact server acceptance. Actual acceptance is bounded by Send and this receipt.
Three UI questions: 你希望这款俄罗斯方块采用哪种核心规则与操作体验？ / 画面视觉与背景音乐更偏向哪种风格？ / 主要在什么设备与屏幕方向下游玩？ Full option text is captured.

Selected and sent: 纯粹怀旧街机版（仅保留下一个方块预览，无虚影与暂存，原汁原味硬核挑战）; 清爽极简积木风（干净柔和配色、圆润木质或糖果色方块，配轻松舒缓音乐）; 竖屏通用布局（推荐：棋盘居中视野大，底部带触屏操控键，手机触屏与电脑键盘都能顺畅玩）. Reason: frozen policy chooses classic single-player 2D, simple original visuals and keyboard support. One reply to actual questions, no extra feature/repair request. About 41 seconds of observer/answer latency remains included.
Follow-up text accepted; creator resumes work.
Creator still working; no final build.
